name: toolbox
title: Toolbox
description: Personal Raycast commands from the toolbox repository: GitLab merge requests, and a zsh command line.
author: pavel_smirnov

commands.name: show-mrs
commands.title: GitLab: Show MRs
commands.description: Pick a project, then browse and filter its merge requests.

commands.name: mr-name
commands.title: GitLab: MR Name
commands.description: Copy a merge request link titled with the merge request's name. Takes the link as its argument or from the root search as a fallback command; without one, opens a prompt filled in from the clipboard.

commands.name: shell
commands.title: Shell
commands.subtitle: zsh
commands.description: Run a command in zsh from the home directory, with your ~/.zshrc, and show what it prints. Without a command, opens a full-width prompt with the commands run before.

preferences.name: claudeUsername
preferences.title: Claude's GitLab Username
preferences.description: Whose merge requests By Claude (⌘2) shows.
